Hi Lina / Mathias — thanks for the clear asks. Summary of what we can deliver and a proposal attached. Highlights below: 

1) EU primary residency (12‑month renewal)
- We can pin primary data processing and storage to eu-west-1 for the renewal term. This includes encrypted KV caches and audit logs stored in the EU region.
- Price delta: +18% on hosted usage unit price OR a fixed monthly surcharge of €6,500 for dedicated tenancy (option depends on committed capacity). See attached PDF (scandmed-eu-onramp-quote-v2.pdf).

2) APAC warm-standby (ap-southeast-1)
- Standby SKU: minimal reserved capacity (warm nodes idle with synchronized model binaries & KV snapshot). Recommended starting SKU: 4 warm GPUs (gpus-equivalent), monthly surcharge: $9,000 USD.
- Failover model: automated traffic routing + canary warmup. Expected cold-start RTO when routing switched automatically: ~6–12 minutes for full KV restore at current model sizes; with prefix-warmup we can target sub-3 minute RTO for critical routes. RPO: near-zero for requests after replication cutoff; KV snapshot cadence configurable (default 15s).

3) Staggered EU onramp (two waves)
- Wave 1 (Q3 week 1–3): EU primary for admin + low-volume routes (10–20% traffic).
- Wave 2 (Q3 week 4–6): Full traffic cutover for core product.
- Rollback plan: automatic fallback to global-hosted endpoint for 15 minutes, then manual ops step if issues persist.

Next steps I suggest:
- Approve the attached quote or tell us which pricing option you prefer (surcharge vs per-unit).
- Sign DocuSign for the EU residency amendment (link below).
- Schedule 1.5 hr ops working session (we'll include Karhtik for runbook + Grace for onboarding).

Hi Lina / Mathias — Karthik here from Infra + Delivery. A few operational clarifications and confirmation items from our side before we finalize the SOW: 

- Runbook & failover behavior: attached is a first-draft "standby-runbook-draft.docx" that spells out the automated routing flow, health-check thresholds, and the manual escalation path. Key RTO assumptions are called out on p.6.
- Prefix warmup: confirmed — for your most-requested endpoints we can prepopulate the KV layer and run a 10‑minute synthetic prefix workload during the warmup window. That reduces observed RTO to ~90–180s depending on model size. We'll only commit to sub-3 min for a small subset of routes that you nominate.
- Data segregation: audit logs, user vectors, and billing metadata will remain in eu-west-1. We will provide a signed addendum to the contract to reflect this.
- Staggered roll: suggested cutover calendar (attached). Wave 1 will include feature flags to limit routing; Wave 2 will lift flags and run a 2‑hour monitor window before declaring green.

Ask: please send the list of critical routes (up to 6) and an example traffic profile for each so we can size the warm nodes precisely. Once we get that, operations will finalize the SKU recommendation and we can update pricing.

I have scheduled a 90-minute working session for Mon Mar 22 09:00 CET — invite has been sent.

Regards,
